name: published-shuttle-source-baseline-v1
inference: Unchanged application TrackNet, CUDA float16, existing camera/weighted-window/component-selection behavior; no manual annotations
coverage: Attempt every native clip/frame; whole incomplete CSV files remain quarantined and all published rows/unlabelled native frames remain in coverage
scoring: Conditional publisher-reference visibility/localization agreement only; wrong location contributes FP and FN; missing positive is FN; unavailable negative is never TN
component_diagnostic: Count all observed above-threshold components within the same fixed source tolerance, without changing model selection
limitations: Published/pretrained-source data, not an independent unseen holdout or expert-reviewed truth
Mirror authenticity, dataset rights, original identities, cross-corpus overlap and live-scene validity remain unverified
Raw shuttle localization only; no complete-event, player identity, shot recognition or full-match accuracy claim
No training, tuning, new weights, interpolation, model/default installation or promotion
No consumed holdout-63 inputs, predictions, protocols, private membership metadata or artifacts
